messages.subject: Gulf Development | Energy, infrastructure and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Cheunsomchit and Gulf Development Leadership Team,

Gulf's scale across energy, infrastructure and new growth platforms creates the kind of stakeholder complexity where my experience is strongest.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate coordination, social performance, compliance and executive stakeholder strategy.

I have supported the governance and external dimensions of approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage within a remote industrial operation. I also coordinate public-agency interfaces, operating approvals, official engagements, community priorities and carbon-data readiness. This work has trained me to protect project momentum while maintaining institutional trust and internal accountability.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional responsibilities across Sustainability, Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, Strategic Partnerships or Country Strategy. I have attached a Gulf Development-focused executive CV setting out where my background could contribute to the company's next phase of growth.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
